title: Making Apologies
subtitle: Say sorry the right way
description: A genuine apology can go a long way in any language. These phrases will help you apologize naturally in English, whether you're five minutes late or interrupting a conversation.
tip: Follow 'I'm sorry' with a brief explanation and a solution — this three-part structure sounds more sincere and complete than just 'sorry'.
phrases: I'm so sorry I'm late — the traffic was completely unexpected.
I really apologize for the misunderstanding. That was my fault.
Sorry to interrupt, but I just need to ask a quick question.
I take full responsibility for what happened.
I should have let you know sooner — I'm truly sorry about that.
Please accept my apologies. It won't happen again.
I feel terrible about the confusion I caused.
I'm sorry if I came across the wrong way — that wasn't my intention at all.
